desc: Derive and prove the invariant: A (array of final ratings indexed by initial rating) is non-decreasing with A[x+1]-A[x] in {0,1}, and that a contest update adds 1 exactly on a contiguous index interval [p,q].

Choose data structure: lazy segment tree with min/max over A supporting (a) find leftmost index with A[idx] >= L_i, (b) find rightmost index with A[idx] <= R_i, (c) range-add +1 on [p,q], all in O(log V).

Implement the full solution in Python: segment tree over [1, 5e5] initialized A[x]=x, process N contests (compute p, q from current tree state, skip if out of range or p>q, range-add), then answer Q queries via point lookup; fast I/O with sys.stdin.buffer.

Verify correctness against the provided samples by hand-trace (Sample 1 fully traced: 6/6/8 ✓; Sample 2 spot-checked: 8/2003/500001 ✓) and check edge cases: X=1, X=5e5, L_i=R_i, values exceeding 5e5, p>q guard, sentinel integrity under lazy propagation.
Review complexity (O((N+Q) log V) time, O(V) memory) and Python performance; code finalized.
